objective.text: Build a multipart file request instead of placing file bytes in a JSON field.

difficulty.rationale: Send a genuine file part rather than encoding bytes as an ordinary JSON field.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: An API expects a multipart file field named document with filename report.txt. $bytes contains its contents. Which request matches?

options.rationale: URL-encoded form data is not a multipart file part with a filename.
options.misconception: URL-encoded form data is not a multipart file part with a filename.

options.rationale: attach creates a multipart part with the field name, content and filename.
A raw body lacks the named multipart file field required by the endpoint.

options.rationale: This sends a JSON field by default, without multipart file metadata.
